main.description: An organizer-owned named destination within one event edition. The record must be in the event's repository and contains its own display data, independently of any linked persistent stage.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was created. Preserved through place edits.

description.description: The organizer's description of the place, such as access or arrival instructions within the event.

event.description: The DID-based record URI of the events.openmusic.event edition containing this place. A different edition requires a new place identity.

kind.description: The place's primary use. Missing or unrecognized kinds still render using the common place fields.

links.description: Public links for this place, in preferred display order. Missing values are not inherited from a linked stage.

locators.description: Locators for this place. A map pin requires an understood coordinate locator; a place without one remains displayable by name.

media.description: Organizer-selected media for this place, in preferred display order. Blob sources belong to this record's repository. Missing values are not inherited from a linked stage.

name.description: The organizer's name for this place, independent of any persistent stage profile.
